inj.note: Tyson thus is one step closer to making his NFL debut after missing the first eight weeks of the campaign due to hamstring issues that have bothered him since the start of training camp. With a 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff on tap Sunday, his status will be clarified, one way or another, about 90 minutes before that point.

news.h: Sources: Saints to activate WR Jordyn Tyson, LT Kelvin Banks
news.d: Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson and left tackle Kelvin Banks Jr. will be active against the Browns on Sunday.

news.h: Saints' Jordyn Tyson and Kelvin Banks Jr. return to practice
news.d: Report on Jordyn Tyson and Kelvin Banks Jr. returning to Saints practice following the bye week.

news.h: Saints' Jordyn Tyson returns to practice, listed as limited participant
news.d: New Orleans Saints rookie wide receiver Jordyn Tyson took a major step toward making his season debut Wednesday, returning to practice for the first time since injuring his right hamstring in a joint practice against the Jacksonville Jaguars on Aug. 13.
